signedit.name: SignEdit
message.signedit.installCloth: Install Cloth Config API to access mod options
message.signedit.configScreenDisabled: Config screen is not available on this version.
option.signedit.general.useEnhancedEdito: Whether enhanced editing should be enabled when opening the sign editor.
option.signedit.general.showEditorToggle: Whether to show a button to toggle enhanced editing.
option.signedit.general.showActionButton: Whether to show the quick action buttons in the sign editor.
option.signedit.general.actionButtonsClo: Whether clicking the quick action buttons should close the sign editor.
option.signedit.general.showLineBreakInd: Whether to show a symbol where a line is broken manually rather than automatically.
option.signedit.general.saveOnEscape.too: Whether to save the sign content when exiting by pressing the '%s' key rather than clicking the '%s' button.
